blocks.text: Key Features of this Lenovo TouchScreen Laptop (Renewed)● Operating system : Chrome Os● Product Positioning : Education and Student● Memory: 4GB RAM● Hard Drive : 32GB SSD● Processor type: Intel Celeron N4020 1.1GHz, Up to 2.8GHz● Processor speed: 2 cores, 2 threads, 4MB cache●Touchscreen：Yes● Ports:1 x USB-A 3.0 Port1 x USB-C 3.1 Gen 1 Port1 x HDMI1 x Headphone / Microphone Combo Jack (3.5 mm)1 x Micro SD Card Reader（selected models）1 x Kensington Security SlotIncludes:1 x Lenovo Chromebook 300E Gen 2 2-in-1 TouchScreen Laptop (Renewed)1 x AC Adapter

items.label: 【Powerful Processor】
items.value: This renewed Lenovo 300E Gen 2 touchscreen laptop is equipped with an Intel Celeron N4020 processor (1.1GHz, Up to 2.8GHz, 2 cores, 2 threads, 4MB cache ), which delivers strong multi-tasking performance and responsive speed for daily office work, web browsing, document editing, and multimedia tasks.

items.label: 【Sufficient Storage Space】
items.value: This renewed Lenovo Chromebook comes with 4 RAM and 32 hard drive space, which can help you run multiple software and browsers simultaneously without lagging, and has enough space to download files, bringing you a wonderful experience.

items: 【Rich Ports】This renewed Lenovo Chromebook TouchScreen Computer is equipped with multiple ports (1 x USB-A 3.0 Port, 1 x USB-C 3.1 Gen 1 Port, 1 x HDMI, 1 x Headphone / Microphone Combo Jack (3.5 mm)，1 x Micro SD Card Reader（selected models）, 1 x Kensington Security Slot ), allowing you to fully experience the fun brought by technology. With the connection of microphone and headphones, it can also bring you a pleasant music journey.

【Four-Mode Flexibility with Pencil Touch Technology】：This versatile 11.6" 2-in-1 Chromebook features a durable 360-degree hinge that adapts to 4 learning modes—Laptop, Tablet, Stand, and Tent—ideal for writing essays, marking documents, viewing lessons, or collaborating in class. Equipped with innovative Pencil Touch technology, its 10-point multi-touch screen supports precise, scratch-free interaction using a standard No. 2 pencil, offering better accuracy than finger control for note-taking, drawing, and test-taking, all while delivering a premium classroom experience.

items.label: 【Stable System】
items.value: This renewed Chromebook is equipped with the Chrome Os, providing you with a secure and stable operating environment, preventing data loss during the operation process.

items.label: 【HD Screen Display & 1.3kg】
items.value: This renewed Chromebook 300E Gen 2 2-in-1 Notebook is equipped with a 11.6" HD(1366×768) Screen Display , which can provide you with clear images. Meanwhile, this laptop weighs only 1.3 kilograms, making it the best choice for your eduation, student and travels.

items: 【Refurbished trait】-The power supply and charger of refurbished products may not be original, but they are compatible with the computer and fully functional. The product is delivered in an ordinary packaging box, not the original packaging box.
